items.description: Confirm the current branch and announce it to the user before making changes.
Confirm the working tree is clean or existing changes are intentionally excluded from release work.
Increment the firmware patch version from the latest origin release and confirm the candidate tag does not already exist.
items.evidence: Origin latest release v2.0.3; v2.0.4 was unused and is the exact next patch.

items.description: Confirm local semantic release tags match origin without moving any published tag.
items.evidence: All local semantic release tag object IDs matched origin; no remote tag was changed.

items.description: Confirm the intended firmware version in SignalSlinger/defs.h and matching repo-root README asset references.
items.evidence: SW_REVISION and both README update assets use 2.0.4.

items.description: Decide the release channel for main or Development2.
Freeze and record the exact clean source commit used for release builds.
Prepare release integration in a clean worktree so unrelated local changes cannot enter the release.
Run just check and just secrets at the frozen source commit.
Run the normal, relocated, and bootloader repeatability checks with pinned tools and zero warnings.
Generate both hardware-specific release packages, manifests, checksums, READMEs, and ZIP archives.
Independently validate package contents, hashes, ZIP members, and flash geometry.
Complete representative hardware programming, update, recovery, and version-report checks.
Install each hardware build on a representative unit and capture its INF version report.
Select and verify the prior release package and documented recovery path.
Document the salient user-observable changes since the previous release in the checked release-notes file.
Document significant stability and reliability improvements since the previous release in the checked release-notes file.
On Development2, leave changes uncommitted unless the user explicitly asks for a commit.
Obtain explicit approval to integrate the release candidate into main.
Re-run release-preflight from the clean integrated main commit.
Obtain explicit approval for the release tag and GitHub publication.
Create and push an annotated release tag at the verified commit.
Create the GitHub release using --notes-file with the checked release notes and the requested prerelease or normal release channel.
Upload both hardware assets to the release.
Verify the remote release body matches the checked notes file, both required change sections remain present, all assets are downloadable, and branch README targets are correct.
